Q-2626: How many days are there from 2021-07-18 to 2021-10-19 (count the end date but not the start date)?

Answer: 93

Calculation: July 18 to July 31 = 13 days, August = 31, September = 30, October 1-19 = 19. Total = 13 + 31 + 30 + 19 = 93 days.
